scope: Application-scale evidence for a new synthetic workload, not measured customer SLAs or benchmarked processor cycles
application_anchor: Non-control-loop image inspection and event analysis with second-scale service deadlines

sources.title: EP-MUSTO: Entropy-Enhanced DRL-Based Task Offloading in Secure Multi-UAV-Assisted Collaborative Edge Computing
sources.authors: Longxin Zhang; Runti Tan; Buqing Cao; Lihua Ai; Kenli Li; Kenqin Li
sources.use: Magnitude anchors for input size and computation intensity
sources.limits: Its security costs, energy objective and algorithm are not adopted; these are not measured image-model cycle counts. The selected uniform 500-1000 distribution is our interpolation, not its exact distribution.

sources.title: Hierarchical Online Optimization Approach for IRS-enabled Low-altitude MEC in Vehicular Networks
sources.authors: Yixian Wang; Geng Sun; Zemin Sun; Jiacheng Wang; Changyuan Zhao; Daxin Tian; Dusit Niyato; Shiwen Mao
sources.use: Second-scale deadline sensitivity envelope and compute-density range
sources.limits: Its data-size range is Mbit and is not used to justify MB-sized inputs. It assumes one task per vehicle per slot; that arrival cap is not adopted. The specific 2-3 second primary SLA is our declared research assumption.

sources.title: Research on UAV-MEC Cooperative Scheduling Algorithms Based on Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
sources.authors: Yonghua Huo; Ying Liu; Anni Jiang; Yang Yang
sources.use: Precedent for stochastic Poisson task arrivals in a slotted UAV-MEC model
sources.limits: It does not establish our arrival-rate values, spatial weights or burst factor. Our per-second Poisson batches are not continuous within-slot arrival simulation.

sources.title: ALERT: Accurate Learning for Energy and Timeliness
sources.authors: Chengcheng Wan; Muhammad Santriaji; Eri Rogers; Henry Hoffmann; Michael Maire; Shan Lu
sources.use: Boundary: interactive inference can require at most about one second and can be much faster; resource contention changes latency
sources.limits: Does not support calling 2-5 seconds an interactive-video or safety-control SLA. We use an event-level inspection abstraction and do not claim a measured mapping to these image models.

declared_choices.arrivals: Per-macro-slot Poisson batch followed by weighted UE draws with replacement; same UE may generate multiple tasks
declared_choices.physical_capacity: Keep original five UAV budgets 75/60/70/85/50 Gcycle/s and MBS 200 Gcycle/s; keep original bandwidth pools
declared_choices.capacity_reasoning: Mean task demand 13.5 Gcycle; five-UAV ideal aggregate service approximately 25.19 tasks/s. A geometric reference coverage fraction 5*pi*100^2/700^2 is about 0.321, giving nominal offered-work ratios about 0.255/0.509/1.273/1.527 at 20/40/100/120 arrivals/s. These are only dimensional design references, not policy admission predictions.
declared_choices.selection: No RL results. First test the predeclared normal-SLA/rate-1 setting; if it fails, select by prespecified nondegeneracy/queue/recovery criteria and proximity to the declared setting, then freeze before new-workload validation. Never rank settings by which controller wins.
